additions.reason: The maavarta (passage/slot) of the tefillin is the structural component through which the strap (yirah) passes into the mochin. The Rebbe explicitly equates the entire mechanism — 'this is the aspect of the maavarta of tefillin' — as the central metaphor of the Torah. It belongs to Package 1 (da'at/mochin/tefillin) as a structural sub-component of the tefillin apparatus, though it could also function as neutral since it serves as the conduit between both packages.
additions.source_quote: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת מַעְבַּרְתָּא שֶׁל תְּפִלִּין, כִּי תְּפִלִּין הֵם בְּחִינַת מֹחִין, וְהָרְצוּעָה הִיא בְּחִינַת יִרְאָה

additions.reason: The suffering (tzaar) that comes to a person each day is a central concept in this Torah. The Rebbe explicitly says it flows from the yirah (the strap) threading through the mochin. Tzaar itself is neither holy nor evil — it is the neutral pressure-point that can tip toward holy yirah (Package 2) or fallen yirah (Package 3). It belongs most closely to the yirah/malkhut package as the experiential result of yirah's presence, though it is a bridge concept.
additions.source_quote: צָרִיךְ שֶׁיִּהְיֶה לוֹ אֵיזֶה צַעַר בְּכָל יוֹם, וְגַם מִי שֶׁדַּעְתּוֹ יוֹתֵר גְּדוֹלָה, צַעֲרוֹ גָּדוֹל בְּיוֹתֵר

additions.reason: The Rebbe says that when one eats in holiness, the mouth becomes 'bechina of tzurat adam' (human stature). This is framed as 'naaseh mehappe bechina komat adam' — the mouth IS an aspect of human stature. This is a bechina: the sanctified mouth = human stature. The concept belongs to Package 2 (yirah/malkhut domain) because it is achieved through drawing yirah into the mouth. It is the positive result-state: malkhut/yirah entering the mouth transforms the mouth into human speech-capacity.
additions.source_quote: עַל־יְדֵי־זֶה נַעֲשֶׂה הַפֶּה בִּבְחִינַת קוֹמַת אָדָם, בִּבְחִינַת: מִי שָׂם פֶּה לָאָדָם

additions.reason: The Rebbe explicitly states that the elevated mouth becomes 'bechina of the supernal Adam' — the divine figure on the Merkavah (Ezekiel 1:26). This is called a bechina: 'Shkhina medaberet mitokh gronyo' (the Shekhinah speaks from his throat) IS 'bechina of the supernal Adam.' This belongs to Package 2 as the highest expression of the yirah/malkhut/speech cluster — when malkhut/yirah fully enters the mouth, it becomes the cosmic mouth of the Shekhinah.
additions.source_quote: נִתְעַלֶּה בְּחִינַת קוֹמַת אָדָם הַנַּ"ל וְנַעֲשֶׂה בְּחִינַת אָדָם הָעֶלְיוֹן, בִּבְחִינַת: וְעַל הַכִּסֵּא דְּמוּת כְּמַרְאֵה אָדָם עָלָיו מִלְמָעְלָה

additions.reason: The Rebbe uses this phrase explicitly as a bechina: the supernal Adam IS 'the Shekhinah speaking from his throat.' This is the bechina of malkhut (Shekhinah) inhabiting the mouth/throat — the culmination of the yirah entering the mouth through holy eating. Belongs to Package 2 as the peak expression of the malkhut/yirah/speech cluster.
additions.source_quote: שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת אָדָם הָעֶלְיוֹן, בְּחִינַת: שְׁכִינָה מְדַבֶּרֶת מִתּוֹךְ גְּרוֹנוֹ, בְּחִינַת: אֲדֹנָי שְׂפָתַי תִּפְתָּח

additions.reason: The Rebbe explicitly names the sitra achra as the domain toward which fallen fear / suffering cascades. It is the evil mirror of the entire teaching — when the strap (retzua) becomes evil (retzua bisha), it pulls toward the sitra achra, described as 'din kashe' (harsh judgment). This belongs to Package 3 as the structural domain of evil from which the fallen yirah emanates.
additions.source_quote: שֶׁלֹּא יִהְיֶה נִשְׁתַּלְשֵׁל מִן הַצַּעַר, חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, הִשְׁתַּלְשְׁלוּת אֶל הַסִּטְרָא־אָחֳרָא, שֶׁהִיא דִּין קָשֶׁה

notes: The Torah has 28 entries with reference 1077, of which 14 are bechina-type (counting deduplicated unique edges). Several entries are duplicate edges (identical node pairs and proof text) and were counted once.
One entry (line 43585) has type 'cause' (חכמה ודעת — יראה) rather than 'bechina' and was excluded from the bechina graph.
The node pair מחין/מוחין appears with two spellings in the dataset (both meaning 'mochin/intellect'). They were treated as the same node for component analysis.

The dominant practical mechanism of the Torah — אכילה בקדשה (eating in holiness) — appears only in eitza edges as the cause that produces sweetening, drawing yirah into the mouth, etc. It is not bechina-linked to other nodes and therefore has no package membership. It is the eitza that flows between Package 2 (yirah) and the outcome nodes.

Package 2 is notably large because the dataset encodes many aspectual variations of the same strap-equals-yirah equation (הרצועה/רצועה/רצועה של תפלין/רצועה דקדשה/רצועה שעוברת בתוך המעברתא) — these are all bechina expressions of the same essential node.
